# Code of Conduct / 行为准则

Everyone participating in issues, pull requests and other project spaces should
be respectful, constructive and considerate. Welcome different backgrounds and
experience levels, critique ideas rather than people, and respect privacy.
Harassment, discrimination, threats, sexualized conduct, doxxing and sustained
personal attacks are not acceptable. These expectations also apply when someone
represents this project publicly.

所有 Issue、PR 和项目交流参与者应尊重他人、建设性沟通，欢迎不同背景和经验，
讨论方案而非攻击个人，尊重隐私。不得骚扰、歧视、威胁、发表性骚扰言论、曝光隐私或
持续人身攻击。代表项目进行公开活动时同样适用。

Report concerns privately to the repository owner using a contact method they
have published. If none is available, request a private moderation channel in an
issue without naming people or disclosing details. A published private moderation
contact is required by the release checklist; GitHub does not provide general
private messaging. Do not use a public issue to publish personal allegations.

通过仓库所有者公开的私密联系方式报告问题。若尚未提供，仅在 Issue 中请求建立私密
管理渠道，不公开人员身份或事件细节。发布清单要求维护者提供该渠道；GitHub 没有通用私信功能。

Maintainers review the context, seek clarification where needed, and protect
reporter privacy as far as practical. Responses may include a correction request,
warning, content removal, temporary participation restriction or permanent ban,
according to severity and repetition. Threats and disclosure of private data may
require immediate removal. Appeals go privately to the repository owner or an
uninvolved maintainer; see [governance](../docs/GOVERNANCE.md).

维护者核查上下文并尽可能保护报告者隐私，根据严重程度与重复情况采取纠正请求、警告、
删除内容、暂时限制或永久禁入。威胁及隐私泄露可立即处理。申诉私密交由仓库所有者或
未涉事维护者，详见治理规范。
